headline: Debutant Saqib Khan took 7-130 as Sri Lanka were all out for 446 on day four of the first Test against Pakistan in Rawalpindi on Thursday, Business Recorder (AFP) reports.

card.desc: Pakistan 39-1 at lunch on day four, 27 runs ahead.

caption:
Debut star Saqib Khan takes 7 wickets! 🏏
According to Business Recorder (AFP), Saqib Khan took 7 wickets for 130 runs in his first Test as Sri Lanka were all out for 446 on day four of the first Test in Rawalpindi on Thursday. He is only the fourth Pakistani to take seven wickets in an innings on debut. Sri Lanka lost their last six wickets for 42 runs and took a first-innings lead of 12. At lunch, Pakistan were 39-1, 27 runs ahead.
